i: ABDIAS, whose name is interpreted THE SERVANT OF THE Lord, is believed to have prophesied about the same time as OSEE, JOEL, and AMOS: though some of the Hebrews, who believe him to be the same with ACHAB's steward, make him much more ancient. His prophecy is the shortest of any in number of words, but yields to none, says ST. JEROME, in the sublimity of mysteries. It contains but one chapter.

a.1: The destruction of Edom for their pride: and the wrongs they did to Jacob: the salvation and victory of Israel.

1:12: You shall not look, etc... or, you should not, etc. It is a reprehension for what they had done, and at the same time a declaration that these things should not pass unpunished.-Ibid. You shall not magnify your mouth... That is, you shall not speak arrogantly against the children of Judah as insulting them in their distress.
